gpt_review.verdict: unprofitable, miscalibrated, and still on probation
gpt_review.thesis: The bot has stopped the most catastrophic behavior, but the live stack is still losing badly enough that survival—not growth—is the job. Grok_live is less broken than the legacy/rule junk, yet its edge estimates still do not deserve trust.
strengths: The worst source of damage is clearly identified: crypto/rule/legacy logic was a disaster and is now effectively quarantined.
Open trade count is low enough that portfolio sprawl is no longer the main problem.
Grok_live has produced a few legitimate wins, so the system may be salvageable with tighter selection.
The current heuristic settings are directionally right: smaller size, higher thresholds, and blocked props.
problems: Overall stats are still awful: 15% win rate, -3.78 expectancy per trade, and 0.13 profit factor.
Grok_live remains meaningfully negative at -2.36 expectancy and 0.28 profit factor.
Confidence and edge are still miscalibrated, especially in soccer where 79% average confidence produced ugly losses.
NBA trades were thin-edge garbage and should never have cleared live filters.
Duplicate exposure on the same soccer event amplified losses and shows weak risk controls.
The bot is still trading too many subjective opinions instead of waiting for high-clarity, catalyst-backed spots.
actions: Keep crypto, FX, multi, and props hard-blocked with no exceptions.
Add same-event and same-thesis deduplication so one match cannot create multiple correlated positions.
Restrict live trading to straight sides/moneylines only until grok_live posts positive expectancy over a larger sample.
Raise entry standards further and reject low-quality single-digit edges unless confidence and catalyst quality are exceptional.
Pause soccer if the next 3 settled soccer trades are not net positive.
Keep max one new live trade per run and maintain very low concurrent exposure until at least 25 grok_live trades settle with improved expectancy.
Run calibration audits by family and confidence bucket; if 75%+ confidence picks are still losing, raise thresholds again instead of trusting the score.
